<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ATTLIST book category CDATA "fiction">
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY publisher "O'Reilly Media">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY cover SYSTEM "cover.png" NDATA png>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <book id="b1" category="tech" xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org/b1">
    <title>XML &publisher; Guide</title>
    <author>Jane Doe</author>
    <price currency="USD">39.99</price>
  </book>
</catalog>
```
